notes: The article τά before ὑποδήματα is unrepresented because the relative οὗ carries the possessive whose, which is rule 20's displacement.
The italicized second in (t036) is a repeated function word under rule 103, a rule 7 helper on the member it introduces, and is not added; it is not stretched back over the first ἐν under rule 15.
ὀπίσω is an improper preposition rendered by the single word after, so rule 71's frame question does not arise and μου keeps a bare me.
